name: oh-my-fable
description: Anthropic's Claude prompting guides (Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5) as a plugin: install and forget. Always-on rules by hook, per-request prompt improvement, optional setup.

plugins.name: oh-my-fable
plugins.description: Always-on working rules from Anthropic's Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5 prompting guides via SessionStart and SubagentStart hooks, unattended sessions detected automatically; /fable-prompt rewrites rough requests; /fable-status shows what is in effect; /fable-audit finds guide sections your rules are missing, read-only; /fable-setup is optional.
